ud3.2:2.2: “Sir, Venerable Nanda, the Buddha’s brother and maternal cousin, informed several mendicants:
ud3.2:2.3: “I lead the spiritual life dissatisfied. I am unable to keep up the spiritual life. I shall resign the training and return to a lesser life.’”
ud3.2:16.6: ‘Sir, Venerable Nanda—who is both the Buddha’s half-brother and maternal cousin—has realized the undefiled freedom of heart and freedom by wisdom. He lives having realized it with his own insight in this very life due to the ending of defilements.’
